svg.title: Daily Orders pipeline
svg.desc: Seven numbered steps: 1 download the Olist CSVs from Kaggle; 2 seed the Postgres Shop Database and the Excel Merchandising Catalog with Python; then, orchestrated daily by Airflow at 00:00 WIB (Asia/Jakarta): 3 Python loads Bronze in ClickHouse, 4 dbt builds Silver and sends bad rows to the Quarantine, 5 dbt builds the Gold fact, 6 dbt rebuilds the Gold dimensions and the daily Revenue view; 7 reconcile compares Gold Revenue with the Shop Database. Everything runs in Docker Compose and is tested with pytest.
svg.text: Olist shop → ClickHouse star schema, one Business Date per run · ELT with Python + dbt
Revenue by Product Category per day
Docker Compose: shop-db (Postgres 17) · warehouse (ClickHouse 25.8) · airflow (3.1) · warehouse-test
